open_points.subject: A1 INV-01 Required tests
open_points.text: after a scan, a placement, a repeated placement and a mark, the source folder holds the same files with the same bytes, modification times and modes
open_points.question: Must the witness also prove that directories and all other source-folder metadata are unchanged, and that no move occurred, as required by “changes, moves or deletes anything” in INV-01?
options: Check only file membership, bytes, modification times and modes
Check the complete source tree, including paths, directories and every observable metadata change
open_points.default_guess: Check the complete recursive tree and at least paths, bytes, modes and timestamps before and after.

witness.initial: A source tree contains a file and a subfolder with unchanged file bytes, modification times and modes.
events: The deliverer scans and places the file.
The implementation changes the subfolder metadata or moves the file away and back while restoring the listed file properties.
outcomes: The described Required tests comparison passes.
INV-01 fails because an operation changed or moved something in the source folder.
witness.observer: The invariant verifier or an observer of directory metadata during the operation.

open_points.subject: A1 INV-02 Required tests
open_points.text: for content with no placement, an empty or absolute name, a name with an empty, `.` or `..` segment, an ignored name at any level, a folder, and a path through a symbolic link each fail with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure and add no file except the project lock, and a trace of every file the process opens while the delivery runs shows no opening of the named file, of a folder past the segment that fails or of a link's target
open_points.question: Must the witness cover every way A3 rule 5 condition 1 can fail, including an absent segment, a folder-opening failure, an absent final segment and unreadable final metadata, or only the cases enumerated here?
options: Only the enumerated malformed, ignored, folder and symbolic-link cases
Every failure included in condition 1 of A3 rule 5
open_points.default_guess: Cover every condition-1 failure and prove that no path beyond the failing segment is opened.

open_points.subject: A3 INV-06 Required tests
open_points.text: a second placement returns the first publication and leaves every stored image and placement record unchanged, with one placement record in place
open_points.question: Must the repeated-placement test also prove that an existing publication mark is not written or changed, since INV-06 says the repeated placement writes nothing and A3 rule 2 explicitly includes marks?
options: Only stored images and placement records must be checked
Stored images, placement records and publication marks must all be checked for absence of writes
open_points.default_guess: Assert that the image, placement record and mark are all byte-for-byte unchanged and not rewritten.

witness.initial: A placement and its publication mark already exist.
events: The implementation rewrites the mark with identical logical content while leaving the image and placement record unchanged.
outcomes: The Required tests observations stated for INV-06 pass.
The formal invariant that a repeated placement writes nothing fails.
witness.observer: A filesystem-write trace or an observer of the mark file's metadata.

open_points.subject: A3 INV-07 Required tests
open_points.text: a removed file keeps its delivery
open_points.question: What exact durable facts must “keeps its delivery” prove remain unchanged after removal: the placement record, stored image and publication mark, or only the placement returned to the caller?
options: The placement record, stored image and mark all remain unchanged
open_points.default_guess: Require the placement record, stored image and mark all to remain unchanged.

open_points.subject: A3 INV-19 Required tests
open_points.text: delivering content that has no placement under the name of a conflict copy fails with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure, adds no file except the project lock and changes no existing file
open_points.question: Must the witness trace file access and prove that the conflict copy is never opened or read, or is the failure response with no durable change sufficient?
options: The response and durable-state assertions are sufficient
The test must additionally prove that the conflict copy is not opened or read
open_points.default_guess: Trace opens and reads and prove rejection occurs before the conflict copy is opened.

witness.initial: An unplaced conflict-copy file contains valid image bytes.
events: The caller asks to deliver it by its conflict-copy name.
Implementation one rejects the name before opening the file; implementation two reads the file and then returns the same failure without writing durable state.
outcomes: Both implementations satisfy the described Required tests result.
Only the first satisfies INV-19, which says a new placement never reads a conflict copy.

open_points.subject: A4 INV-08 Required tests
open_points.question: Must the conflicting-photo test also assert that the existing mark is wholly unchanged, or does checking only the refusal satisfy the Required tests item?
options: Check the refusal and prove that the existing mark was neither changed nor rewritten
open_points.default_guess: Check the refusal and compare the complete mark and its file metadata before and after.

witness.initial: A placement has a mark for photo id A.
events: The caller marks the same placement with photo id B.
One implementation refuses without writing; another overwrites the mark and then returns the refusal.
outcomes: Both return the refusal named by the Required tests sentence.
witness.observer: A later scan or repeated placement that reads the mark.

open_points.subject: A7 INV-13 Required tests
open_points.text: a counting clock is read once by a mark and not at all by a scan, a delivery or the health answer
open_points.question: Which mark paths must demonstrate the clock-reading rule: only a successful new mark, or also a request refused before the reading point, a request refused after it, a replay and a publication conflict?
options: Only a successful new mark is required
Each distinct mark outcome and refusal position must assert its prescribed clock count
open_points.default_guess: Test zero reads for pre-clock refusals and exactly one read for successful, replayed, conflicting and post-clock-refused marks.

open_points.subject: A11 old-date classification
open_points.text: a project holding a date with an offset is detected before delivery, and a project holding only UTC dates passes
open_points.question: Does “UTC dates” mean only the required UTC-without-offset representation, or does it include an ISO 8601 value ending in `Z`, which A11 rule 1 classifies as an old date?
options: Only UTC values without `Z` or a numeric offset pass
Values ending in `Z` also count as UTC dates and pass
open_points.default_guess: Only UTC values without any offset designator pass.

witness.initial: The Portal staff photo list contains only `2026-01-02T03:04:05Z`.
events: The calling flow performs the old-date check before delivery.
outcomes: A11 rule 1 classifies the value as old and stops delivery.
The phrase “only UTC dates passes” can be read to allow it because `Z` denotes UTC.
witness.observer: The owner attempting to start the delivery.

open_points.subject: A11 INV-17 Required tests
open_points.text: The calling flow's own stop is shown when that flow exists.
open_points.question: What observable result must the eventual witness show: no placement call, no Portal publication call, both, and whether the owner notification is also required?
options: Showing detection or an abstract stopped state is enough
The witness must show zero placement and publication calls and the required owner notification
open_points.default_guess: Show that neither placement nor publication is attempted and that the owner is told which project needs repair.
